sentences.text:
On The 8th Of September, 2025
 Misc. Appeal No. 3371 of 2025
 Praveen Kale
 Versus
 Ankit Daade And Others
Appearance:
Ms. Shikha Baghel - Advocate for the appellant.
Shri Deepchand Gupta - Advocate for the respondent no.3  ORDER Heard on IA No.7961/2025, which is an application for condonation of delay.
2. For the reasons mentioned in the application, the same is allowed.
Delay is hereby condoned.
3. The present appeal under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicle Act, 1988 has been filed against the award dated 23.0.2024, passed in MACC No.14/2022 by 5th Additional MACT, Chhindwara.
By the said award, learned Tribunal has partly allowed the claim case and awarded compensation to the tune of Rs.93,741/- along with the interest of 6% per annum.

4. The factual matrix of the case is that on 02.12.2021 at about 5:30 PM, appellant aged about 19 years was going home on a NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:42965 2 MA-3371-2025 motorcycle along with his friend as a pillion rider.

When they reached near Boargaon Petrol Pump,
one TATA Indica Car bearing registration No.MP-28-CA-5770 coming from Nagpur road and being driven by respondent No.1 in a rash and negligent manner dashed them, due to which, the appellant-claimant fell down on the road and sustained grievous injuries.
5. Learned Claims Tribunal found that the accident was caused due to rash and negligent driving of respondent No.1.
The offending vehicle was insured with respondent No.3/Insurance Company on the fateful day.

The appellant /claimant filed a claim petition for a compensation of Rs.8,55,000/-
6.

Learned MACT awarded Rs.6241/- under the head of "medical expenses", Rs.10,000/- under the head of "Transportation", Rs.15000/- under the head of "loss of income due to accident",
Rs.22,500/- for "attender" and Rs.12,000/- for "special diet" and Rs. 25,000/- for pain and suffering.

Thus in total, learned MACT awarded Rs.93,741/- as against Rs.8,55,000/-

sentences.text: It is not in dispute that respondent was responsible for causing the accident.
The only question for determination in this appeal is that whether the amount awarded by the Tribunal requires modification or not?.
8. I have heard the rival submissions of learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:42965 3 MA-3371-2025 9.

After going through the record and hearing the submissions advanced by learned counsel for the parties, I find that Tribunal has awarded lower side amount under various heads which is modified and recalculated in the table below for ready reference:
Amount of Amount of compensation compensation assessed Head awarded by Claims by this Court Tribunal Transportation Rs.10,000/- Rs.15,000/- Special Diet Rs.12,000/- Rs.15,000/-
 Attender Rs.22,500/- Rs.30,000/
 Medical Expenses Rs.6,241/- Rs.6,241/-
 Loss of Income Rs.15,000/- Rs.15,000/
 Pain and Suffer Rs.25,000/- Rs.50,000/
 Litigation Expenses  Rs.3000/- Rs.3000/-

For fractur sustained on  - Rs.40,000/
 left leg.
 Total Rs.93741/- Rs.1,74,24 10.

Considering the overall facts and circumstances of the case, the appellant is entitled for enhancement for a sum of (Rs.1,74,241/- -
Rs.93,741/- = Rs.80,500/-).
The enhanced amount of Rs.80,500/- shall also carry same interest as has been awarded by the Tribunal.

11. In view of the foregoing discussion, this Court is of the considered opinion that the award passed by the learned Tribunal warrants interference and the compensation amount is liable to be and is hereby enhanced from Rs.93741/- to Rs.1,74,241/-.

Thus after deduction the enhanced amount comes to Rs.80,500/- which shall be payable along with interest 6% per annum from the date of filing of the claim petition NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:42965 4 MA-3371-2025 till its realization against the respondent No.1 to 3/non-applicants jointly and severally.
12. In view of the foregoing discussion, appeal stands partly allowed and the impugned award is modified to the extent indicated herein above subject to following directions:-

"i. The respondent No.3 is directed to deposit the compensation amount within 60 days from the date of this order, failing which the execution can be taken out against Praveen Kale vs Ankit Daade on 8 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/42600855/
2 him.
ii.
The claimant is directed to pay the requisite Court Fee, if required in the present case.
iii. On such deposit, the claimant is permitted to withdraw the amount with accrued interest and costs, by filing a proper application before the Tribunal.
iv. The record be sent back to the learned Tribunal within three weeks from this day.
v. As a sequel, interlocutory applications pending consideration, if any, shall stand closed.
(HIMANSHU JOSHI) JUDGE mn Praveen Kale vs Ankit Daade on 8 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/42600855/
